notes: Piano practice learns hands and fingers: pick R hand or L hand and the practice octave moves to where that hand plays, every key in the window shows its fingering number (1=thumb to 5=pinky), a big finger readout follows the exercise, and Guide mode tells you note AND finger. Typing keys: I, O and P now play the upper black keys, ' extends the range, and a visible octave selector joins the Piano tab (Z/X still work).
